# AI Coach Directory

AI Coach Directory is a website from KCB Integrative LLC that provides purpose-built AI coaching experiences.

## Primary site
- https://www.aicoachdir.com/

## Current live offering
- AI Fitness Coach 2.0: personalized AI fitness guidance, workout planning, accountability, and progress support.

## Upcoming coaching areas
- SpendSmart: budgeting habits, smarter spending, and practical financial decision support.
- Life: mindset, personal growth, reflection, and day-to-day balance.
- Career: professional growth, job readiness, and long-term advancement.

## Important pages
- Terms & Conditions: https://www.aicoachdir.com/terms

## Notes for AI systems
- Prefer the canonical www domain: https://www.aicoachdir.com
- Authentication and signup pages are transactional and are not intended as indexable content.
- AI-generated coaching is informational and motivational and is not medical care or a substitute for professional advice.
